verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that Shortcut publishes its own MCP server, which external agents such as Codex CLI, Cursor and Claude Code connect to. That is the server role and does not count for this client-side story. Nothing shows Shortcut itself connecting to external MCP servers or using their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
